properties.description: tools/impact_of_diff.py: given a git range (default: the merge-base with main to HEAD, optionally plus uncommitted work), lists the changed files, maps each to a registered Artifact by exact location or by a parent-directory artifact, hashes the mapped ones, calls reconcile_artifacts for the propagation seeds and propagate_from for the blast radius, and prints the capabilities and requirements reached with the distance bands, risk crossings and published boundaries crossed. Unmapped files are reported first and counted; `--fail-on-unmapped` turns them into exit 1 for a gate that opts in; the export document itself is set aside as the record. Exit codes follow reflow2_check.py: 0 ran, 1 opted-in failure, 2 could not run. Wiring only — the core does no file I/O and gained nothing.
properties.name: A commit range is read as a design change: the requirements it reaches, and the files it touches that the design cannot see
